Preservation does not hold across the declared reaction results: the structured reaction model exceeds the per-coefficient tolerance at all ten rates. At rho=1, matched-IC error increases from 0.02124 to 0.13005, far beyond the allowed 0.005 increase.

Their saved rel_std is computed across specifications after averaging seeds, not across seed-level aggregate errors. Thus uncertainty reporting does not cover all headline comparisons as required.
